rationale: The pain is real for a narrow class of operators making large GPU purchases, but the evidence base is a single HN comment with no corroborating threads, no competitor pricing data, and no direct 'I'd pay for a calculator' signal. The market is globally small (a few hundred serious operators at any moment), the decision is one-time, and free spreadsheets already satisfy most buyers. This does not meet the 5-distinct-pain-quotes floor or the willingness-to-pay signal requirement.
